bib.title: PEGASUS: Pre-training with Extracted Gap-sentences for Abstractive Summarization

read.skipped: Appendix I sample-output tables (about chars 70000-332878) skimmed only: generated example summaries, no method values.

question: Does a pre-training objective tailored to abstractive summarization (masking and generating whole important sentences) improve transformer encoder-decoders across diverse summarization domains and low-resource settings?
hypothesis: A pre-training objective that closely resembles the downstream task (summary-like generation of principal sentences) gives better and faster fine-tuning performance.
contributions: A new self-supervised objective, gap-sentences generation (GSG), with a study of sentence-selection strategies
Evaluation on 12 downstream datasets with ablations, 568M-parameter model at or above SOTA on all
State-of-the-art on 6 datasets with only 1000 fine-tuning examples
Human evaluation showing human-level summaries on XSum, CNN/DailyMail, Reddit TIFU

method.summary: Standard transformer encoder-decoder pre-trained with GSG: top-scoring sentences (ROUGE1-F1 against the rest of the document) are replaced by [MASK1] and generated as one output sequence. Ablations on a 223M base model pick corpus, objective, GSR and vocabulary, then a 568M model is trained and fine-tuned on 12 datasets and in low-resource settings.

models.name: PEGASUS-large
models.context: 512 input / 256 target in pre-training; fine-tuned up to 1024 input

training.objective: GSG (Ind-Orig, principal sentences by ROUGE1-F1), GSR 30% in ablations and 45% for large with 20% of selected sentences left unchanged in input; MLM (15% tokens, 80/10/10) ablated and dropped from the large model
training.lr: pre-training 0.1 (Table C.1); fine-tuning 5e-4 for base on most datasets, large 5e-5 to 5e-3 by dataset
training.steps: 500k pre-training (1.5M for mixed stochastic model); fine-tuning 12k-300k by dataset; 2k for low-resource
training.seq_len: 512 input, 256 target pre-training; 1024 input for long-document fine-tuning

other.mixed_stochastic_model: C4+HugeNews mixture weighted by example count, GSR sampled uniformly 15%-45%, 20% uniform noise on importance scores, 1.5M steps, tokenizer updated to encode newline
other.low_resource: first 10/100/1k/10k training examples, best validation checkpoint up to 2000 steps
other.fine_tuning_grid: learning rate and length penalty alpha swept per dataset

inference.decoding: greedy in Sec 6.1 ablations and low-resource; beam search size 8 with length penalty alpha (Wu et al. 2016) for large model
inference.max_tokens: max target 32-256 tokens by dataset (Table C.1); BIGPATENT/arXiv/PubMed/Multi-News summaries truncated to 256 in Table 1

metrics.name: Human Likert rating
metrics.definition: 1 (poor) to 5 (great) per summary, median of 3 MTurk workers, paired t-test vs human reference

metrics.name: test-set overlap
metrics.definition: ROUGE-2 recall between test targets and pre-training documents

eval.protocol: Test sets of 12 datasets; ablation scores normalised by first bar; human eval 100 examples per dataset, 4 summaries per task rated by 3 US workers (95% approval, 1000+ HITs, USD 1 per task).

results.quote: PEGASUSLARGE also beat previous state-of-the-art results on 6 out of 12 datasets with only 1000 fine-tuning examples

limits: Authors concede ROUGE over-penalises abstractive summaries and ignores linguistic quality (Sec 6.4)
Inputs capped at 1024 tokens; BIGPATENT, arXiv, PubMed, Multi-News average inputs are longer
Human eval limited to 3 datasets and 100 examples each; Experiment 2 gives fewer ratings per model
Model summaries are less abstractive than human ones (App H)
Compute, hardware, seeds, warmup and precision not stated; HugeNews not released
No factuality evaluation; sample outputs only qualitative
ROUGE-based SOTA claims have dated; later LLMs superseded them

terms.definition: select and mask whole sentences from a document, concatenate them into a pseudo-summary, and generate it from the remaining document
gap sentences ratio: number of selected gap sentences to total sentences in the document
